decisive_items: a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion of mostly fat density with internal areas of soft-tissue density
a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
response.rationale: The presence of a large, fatty mass in the retroperitoneal space with internal soft-tissue areas and its location in the right adrenal gland area is more consistent with myelolipoma than other options.

rejected.why: Lipoma is less likely due to the presence of internal soft-tissue areas within the mass.
Teratoma is less likely due to the specific location and characteristics of the mass, which are more consistent with myelolipoma.
While adrenal myelolipoma is a possible diagnosis, the provided information and assessments better support myelolipoma as the champion.
